developmental_significance: April 8 makes the Root/Mud/Strife system more precise: rootedness, separation, upward sprouting and perception are already linked before later Garden/Gardener formulations mature.
May 25 preserves a dense transitional title stack in which North is simultaneously throne, axis, ladder, field and public/internet frame.
The May cross-cultural material is especially valuable because it expresses synthesis as harmony across lenses/paths rather than as simple doctrinal equivalence.
The 100.000-spirals wording predates or sits alongside later 100,000-hour formulations and should remain a distinct historical stratum until exact relations are sourced.
The Door/Drain sentence shows the project's compression style: a large symbolic architecture reduced to two transition operators and a refusal to over-explain.
